## A short note

This is a *small* piece of prose with a [link](https://example.com/notes),
some "curly quotes", an ellipsis… and an em—dash or two to keep the
typographer busy.

It ends with a second, slightly longer paragraph that gives the inline
parser a little more work: **bold** text, `inline code`, and no lists,
tables or footnotes. Small inputs are where per-call overhead and
setup costs show up most clearly, which is exactly why this fixture
stays boring.
